title: Taiwanese American Organization at UC Davis
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Organization (TAO) at UC Davis is a cultural and social student organization focused on serving Taiwanese Americans and others interested in Taiwanese culture on the UC Davis campus. TAO was founded in approximately 2011 — the name TAO was chosen because “TASA” was already in use at Davis by the Thai American Student Association. The organization adopted the TAO name, a variant used at other UC campuses such as UC Irvine, where the model originated. TAO’s founding at Davis followed the involvement of a student leader with the West Coast ITASA network in 2011.

According to its AggieLife club directory description, TAO’s mission encompasses social and educational programming: through social activities, the organization educates members about Taiwanese culture, history, Taiwan politics, and current events, while also working as a bridge to connect members with other Taiwanese-affiliated organizations. The organization has maintained a Facebook presence at facebook.com/TAOatUCD and a Weebly website at taoatucd.weebly.com. TAO is also referenced as a collaborating organization by Berkeley TASA, which has co-hosted events with UC Davis TAO.

TAO’s current activity level is uncertain — the Weebly website is undated and the most recent verifiable Facebook activity in available search results is not recent. The organization remains listed in the UC Davis registered clubs directory.
